symptom: `verify` printed lint's passthrough line `0 new, 451 already known, 1 fixed` but its lint stage summary omitted the count and `--format json` said `"resolved": 0`; the mxcheck stage filled the same field correctly.
cause: The lint stage read Unchanged and UnchangedBySeverity from lint's baseline object and never read Fixed, so Outcome.Resolved stayed zero.
insight: **When two stages fill one report field, compare what each stage's outcome sets, not just what the runner prints.** The correct sibling (mxcheck) was the control that showed this was an omission. The outcome construction was inline in the runner and so untestable; extracting it was what made a test possible.
